caption: “Photograph of the emission of WintOGreen Lifesavers, taken by Towson State University undergraduate students.” From Linda M. Sweeting. “Scientific Experiments at Home: Wintergreen Candy and Other Triboluminescent Materials.” Towson University (September 1998). [Kodak Ektachrome (EL) color film (ISO 400) was placed under a sheet of Plexiglas; the candy was placed on top of the Plexiglas, covered with another piece of Plexiglas and smashed with a hammer.]
alt: A photograph of a deep blue glow, brightest at the centre and fading to black at the edges, flecked with small dark specks: the light given off by a wintergreen candy as it was crushed on film.
title: Photograph of the emission of WintOGreen Lifesavers
bibliography: Sweeting, Linda M. "Scientific Experiments at Home: Wintergreen Candy and Other Triboluminescent Materials." Towson University, Sept. 1998.
rightsNote: a photograph by Towson State University students, published on Linda M. Sweeting's university page in 1998
